Sprite templates

Templates are recolored live from the chosen palette before insertion.

Sessions

Snapshots and autosave live in your browser's localStorage. Autosave saves once you go idle and again right before you leave.

Saved projects

Only projects saved with Save project appear here. Opening one opens the project's saved baseline; later versions live in Session.

About Fossprite

Fossprite
A complete pixel art studio in a single HTML file.
Features inspired by DogSprite and Simple Pixel Art.
100% offline. Nothing leaves your browser.
DogSprite by systemcrash92 (MIT), dogsprite.org
Simple Pixel Art by comficker (MIT), simplepixelart.com
Themes, design language and palette tools adapted from Simple Pixel Art. Drawing engine, stabilizer, symmetry, pressure, timeline and session recovery adapted from DogSprite. Both original projects are licensed MIT.
